analysis_boundary: The 64-scene block is now used for method analysis and is not an untouched confirmation block. Paired scene counts do not imply identical message loss streams.

metric_semantics.budget_refusals: send requests refused for lack of credit, as recorded by the relay
metric_semantics.emissions: sender-side broadcast events; one event may address multiple recipients
metric_semantics.measured_bytes: metered payload-attempt bytes charged by the relay; packet loss is still charged
metric_semantics.on_time_tasks: number of targets completed before their deadline per episode
metric_semantics.transmission_attempts: recipient transmission attempts; not the number of broadcast emissions
